services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Museum of Chincoteague Island is pleased to offer a variety of field trips. Visits can be tailored to fit your needs and could include presentations, scavenger hunts, and hands-on activities. Please contact the Museum at least 2 weeks in advance to schedule your field trip. Field trips are offered FREE to students

blurb: Mission Statement: The Museum of Chincoteague Island is a non-profit organization dedicated to acquiring, preserving, and exhibiting objects of historical or cultural value to Chincoteague and Assateague Islands.
